description: Verify that the project.json file exists and is valid JSON.
Verify that the project.json contains exactly 3 nodes.
command: python3 -c "import json; data = json.load(open('project.json')); assert len(data['nodes']) == 3, 'Expected 3 nodes'"

description: Verify that all nodes in project.json have a non-empty 'id' field.
command: python3 -c "import json; data = json.load(open('project.json')); assert all(node.get('id') for node in data['nodes']), 'All nodes must have an id'"

description: Verify that the project.json contains a 'status' field set to 'completed'.
command: python3 -c "import json; data = json.load(open('project.json')); assert data.get('status') == 'completed', 'Status must be completed'"
